items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And Mitch Miller just made one comment on hearing

ctx.x: So he got everybody -- somebody, I should say, at Columbia steamed up, and we went over and made a session. And we were all pleased with it. And -- but a strange thing had happened at Columbia. There was now a new head of the pop and jazz and everything department. And I think everyone knows that it was Mitch Miller.
And Mitch Miller just made one comment on hearing
the tape, that he didn't find it exciting.
